name: Claygent: healthcare gap research (fallback only)
agentPrompt:
Organization: {{company_name}} ({{company_domain}}), headquartered in {{city}}, {{state}}. Known specialty: {{specialty}}.
Structured sources already returned: EHR status = {{ehr_status}} (candidates: {{ehr_candidates}}); parent = {{parent_name}} ({{parent_status}}).
Missing fields: {{missing_fields}}.

Research ONLY the missing fields, using the organization's official website, its patient-portal and careers pages, SEC filings/investor relations, and reputable health-industry press.

- ehr: the EHR/practice-management system the organization runs. Accept only an explicit statement (vendor press release, case study, investor filing, job posting that requires daily use of that EHR at this organization). A patient-portal login brand (e.g. MyChart, FollowMyHealth, healow) is a clue only: report it in portal_vendor_clue, and do not return it as the EHR unless it is independently confirmed.
- parent: the ultimate owner. Do not infer ownership from a similar name. Require an acquisition announcement, filing or the organization's own statement.
- location_count: the number of clinic/care locations the organization itself reports, with the date it said so. Do not use LinkedIn headcount.
- org_type: choose the closest option.

For every value give the source URL and a short quote. Leave a field empty and say why in uncertainty_notes when the evidence does not establish it. Never overwrite or contradict a structured result without citing why.

ehr_vendor.description: EHR vendor explicitly confirmed by the evidence; empty if not established

ehr_quote.description: Short supporting quote for the EHR finding

parent_name.description: Ultimate parent organization, empty if not established

location_count.description: Number of care locations the organization reports

location_count_as_of.description: Date or period the location count refers to

org_type.options: [{"text": "primary care network"}, {"text": "multi-site provider group"}, {"text": "specialty provider network"}, {"text": "health system / hospital"}, {"text": "payer"}, {"text": "other"}]

uncertainty_notes.description: What could not be established and why
